content: Hi, how can I support your content project today?
I need help drafting an email to announce a summer sale for our home goods store.

Great! For an effective promotional email, I suggest including: a catchy subject line to drive opens, a brief introduction to set the tone, the main offer details, and a clear call-to-action. These elements help capture attention and encourage readers to act. Would you like me to draft a first version?
Yes, please. Make it concise and upbeat.

Here's a draft:

Subject: Brighten Your Summer - Save Big on Home Essentials!

Body: Summer's here! Enjoy exclusive savings on our best-selling home goods. Refresh your space with up to 30% off select items. Shop now and give your home a seasonal lift.

Call-to-Action: Visit us in-store or online to discover the deals.

Let me know if you'd like any adjustments.
Can you make the subject line even shorter? Our customers read most emails on mobile.

Absolutely. For mobile audiences, a short, direct subject line boosts open rates. Here's a revised option:

Subject: Summer Sale - Up to 30% Off!
That works. Could you add a friendly closing to the body?

Certainly! A warm closing helps strengthen customer connection. Here's the updated body:

Body: Summer's here! Enjoy exclusive savings on our best-selling home goods. Refresh your space with up to 30% off select items. Shop now and give your home a seasonal lift.

We can't wait to see you!
Perfect. I'll use this for our campaign. Thanks for your help!
